installCommand: if [ ! -d "flutter" ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 flutter; fi
buildCommand: if [ ! -d "flutter" ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 flutter; fi && export PATH="$PWD/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter build web --wasm && (cp -u assets/centria_v* build/web/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -u assets/centria_v* build/web/assets/ 2>/dev/null || true)
